period_note: Filed by the bank as 'Financial Statements for the Period January 2025 to June 2025' (a discrete '2nd quarter'-slot filing). Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2024. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2025) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR quality is good. The 31-Dec-2024 comparative matches 2024_Q4.json exactly on every field, and unlike the immediately preceding 2025_Q1.json filing, this quarter's equity roll-forward reconciles cleanly: retained earnings moved from -20,997,161,852 (Dec-2024) to -21,279,005,414 (Jun-2025), a change of exactly -281,843,562, which equals this period's own reported net loss to the taka -- no gap, unlike Q1's filing (see that file's period_note), supporting the view that the Q1 anomaly was an isolated quirk in that one filing rather than a persistent restatement. The H1-2024 comparative P&L column matches 2024_Q2.json's own figures exactly, including EPS: this filing's H1-2024 comparative shows -0.42 (not the -0.43 originally printed in the 2024_Q2 filing's own Notes section), independently confirming the recalculated/corrected EPS value already noted in 2024_Q2.json. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D=0 this quarter -- 'Total provision (D)' is blank/nil, a genuine no-provision quarter rather than a recovery -- PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.42, matching the filing's own Notes section).
